hook: Quad9 is switching off in France today.
hookText: Quad9 is switching off in France today.

beats.say: Today, November 24, 2026, Quad9 will disable its services for French users, starting at 9 in the morning, Paris time.
The morning timing is deliberate, to give unaware users a chance to react during business hours.
From then on, any query reaching a Quad9 address will be refused, and no DNS resolution will succeed, while Quad9 points users to 9.9.9.10, its address with no blocking at all.
